list: the official 55 trophies, verified against Exophase 2026-11-19
sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades from the official list (Exophase, verified live 19 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles agrees on every name, description and grade). Rarity is Exophase's tracked-player rate on 19 Nov 2026. Counts are PSN's progress targets as listed by PSNProfiles. Every guide is our own advice from the official description — the game is a day old and specific locations are not yet checked in-game, so a guide says so where it is not pinned down.

stages.title: The story
stages.note: Chapters 2-4, the finale and the named story missions.

stages.title: Side strands
stages.note: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the strangers.

stages.title: Activities & skills
stages.note: Stunts, ranges, races, fishing, arcade, meditation, bowling, challenges.

stages.title: Collectibles & the map
stages.note: Cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, areas, garages, Scooter Bros.

stages.title: Money & mayhem
stages.note: Shops, vaults, trucks, marked bills, spending, combat feats.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy and this one unlocks by itself. There is no shortcut: it is the sum of the other 54, so follow the roadmap stages in order and let this be the last one you chase.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy almost every player earns — it cannot be missed.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 99.99%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Story chapters complete in order, so keep playing the main missions and this unlocks when the chapter closes.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.73%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks when the chapter's last mission ends — just keep following the story.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.14%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story progress only; no side requirement.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. It is the story's last beat, so it unlocks at the end of the campaign — gold grade, and the last story trophy before the platinum.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it comes up in the campaign order; play it through to the end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.24%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist — follow the mission objectives to the end and it unlocks.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Story mission; it unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Story mission; complete it and the trophy follows.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport; complete it to unlock.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission; complete it to unlock.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long grind behind the platinum: every mission, activity, collectible and challenge counts toward the percentage, so use the tracker to clear each roadmap stage and check the in-game completion stat as you go.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and tricks while driving — chain them in free roam, especially off ramps and jumps around Leonida. PSN tracks the count, so the tracker's counter shows your progress toward 250.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 250). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the game's side activities — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, bowling, meditation, drone races, challenges and more. Sample one of each and it unlocks.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 9 types). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the range's 42 challenges and hit the gold score on each; the range tracks your best medal per challenge, so you can retry any you miss.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 42). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location hosts its own drone race — win each one. The tracker lists the locations as you clear them.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 14). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each race only counts once, so enter 20 different events rather than repeating one. Races are found around Leonida in free roam.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 20). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish against Cal and outscore him in the challenge. Fishing is one of the activities — find a fishing spot and take the challenge when it is offered.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 1.89%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine through to the end of a game. Arcades are found in free roam; one full game is enough.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.41%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand ends with this — play his missions in order until the last one completes.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's strand through to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's strand through to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands appear as you explore — meet the strangers, play their missions, and finish 8 strands. Check each strand early: a strand can close as the story advances, so do not leave them all to the end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 8). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand through to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's strand through to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the map — visit each one and meditate. The tracker counts the spots you have cleared.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 18). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand asks for a specific animal — track it down and hunt it. The animal is unique, so the guide names it once the strand identifies it.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect full sets; 3 complete sets unlocks it. The tracker counts the sets you finish.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 3). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is a photo and check-in activity at spots around the map — do it at 100 different locations. The tracker counts your locations.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 100). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's repeatable feats — finish any 50. The tracker counts them toward the total.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.03%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 50). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and lose the cops. Do it in free roam where you control the heat — it is repeatable, so retry if the level drops first.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.09%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner and keep the wanted level the whole time — plan a route of three close shops and move fast between them.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.05%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 3). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count as discovered when you first drive them — try a wide spread of cars, bikes, boats and aircraft. The tracker counts the vehicles you have found.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.24%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 100). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy fight and aim for a group.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is tied to a sequence at Vice City International Airport — when the chance comes, take the unscheduled way out. Flagged as possibly missable: the game is a day old and it is not yet confirmed whether the departure can be repeated, so do it the first time the airport sequence offers it.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.14%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points at Rhino tanks — get into a Rhino and stir up trouble. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down; the guide will name it once players confirm it.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.14%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, get in and out without tripping the alarm or being spotted. Go when the store is quiet and avoid the guards' sightlines.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults are the big scores — hit five of them and get away clean each time. The tracker counts the vaults you have cleared.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 5). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — hit one, grab the cash and escape. It is repeatable, so retry if the escape fails.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map is split into 52 named areas — visit each one. The tracker counts the areas you have set foot in.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 52). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations — hit one per gang, all 9. The tracker lists the gangs as you clear them.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 9). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find the bar with the view, and order a cocktail. A quiet one — no combat needed.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.08%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a vehicle showroom and drive out through the glass in style. It is a set-piece moment — the exact showroom is not yet pinned down.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. One visit is enough — the follow-through is the point.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.09%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to a partnership moment in the story — the exact beat is not yet confirmed. Flagged as possibly missable: earn it when the story offers the moment, and do not skip past partnership scenes.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 — the trophy is cumulative across the choices you make in the game, not a single decision. Keep playing and making choices; the counter climbs toward 500. Some choices may lock others out, so the guide flags it as one to watch.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.05%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 500). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This is about succeeding on a second try — a retry-based moment. If a first attempt fails, try again and it should unlock.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange event somewhere in Leonida — witness it. Flagged as possibly missable: it reads like a one-time encounter, so when something strange happens, stay and watch it through.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.11%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a drive-by and swing as you pass.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.06%, 19 Nov 2026). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from scores — launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. The tracker counts the amount laundered.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: $250,000). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, food, fuel. It adds up across the whole game, so just keep shopping and the counter climbs.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.05%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: $100,000). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy each of the 8 garages around Leonida. They cost money, so save up and buy them as you find them.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 8). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles you find — 10 registrations unlocks it. The tracker counts your registrations.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list; rarity 0.04%, 19 Nov 2026) · PSNProfiles (PSN count: 10). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.
